sloka: इत्युक्तस्तेन विप्रेण तद्धनु: समुपानयत् ।निमेषान्तरमात्रेण तदानम्य स वीर्य्यवान् ॥ २.११८.४७॥
transliteration: ityuktastena vipreṇa taddhanu: samupānayat ।nimeṣāntaramātreṇa tadānamya sa vīryyavān ॥ 2.118.47॥

translations.english: At the words of that ascetic, my father brought out the bow. Mighty and valiant Rama bent it and strung it and drew it in the twinkling of an eye.
